cands.name: Cynthia Butler
cands.bio: Democrat; registered nurse, nurse union leader (National Nurses United), former EMT/paramedic, single mother and grandmother. Raised in Massachusetts, moved permanently to Florida to care for her mother.
cands.local_ties: Charlotte County homeowner who says she has lived through hurricanes from Charley to Milton (her campaign site); length of residence not stated.

record.text: No elected office. Union organizing on nurse safe-staffing legislation. Priorities: affordable healthcare, homeowners insurance, property taxes, public schools.

cands.name: Danny Nix Jr.
cands.bio: Republican; Realtor with the Nix Team at Coldwell Banker Sunstar, first elected 2024 to succeed Mike Grant. Past chair and trustee of Florida SouthWestern State College, past president of the Economic Development Partnership of Charlotte County.
cands.local_ties: Port Charlotte/Punta Gorda area; has lived in Southwest Florida since about 2011-2012 (Florida Politics, Wikipedia).

record.text: Named a 2026 'Champion for Business' by Associated Industries of Florida; member of the Florida Legislative Aerospace Group.

money_notes.text: In 2024 he launched with $33,500 from donors and a $70,000 self-loan; many $1,000 donors were insurance agents, contractors and engineers. 2026 finance figures not found.

endorsements.text: Then-Rep. Mike Grant (2024); Florida Realtors PAC (2024).
